about.title: Software that works properly in Arabic
about.subtitle: A software company based in Syria, working remotely with clients around the world in Arabic and English.
about.description: We build mobile apps, websites and AI tools, and we treat Arabic as a first language rather than a translation layer: right-to-left layouts, Arabic typography, Hijri dates and mixed-direction text are part of the first build, not a later fix.
